segments.committed: Hi everyone, three things on money today.
First the marketing budget: we keep it flat at two hundred thousand.
Travel is frozen until June, no exceptions without my sign-off.
I will come to the hiring plan in a minute.
Quick note, the coffee machine on the second floor is fixed.
So, hiring: for the second quarter we open four positions, two of them in sales.
On the product side, dark mode ships next week.
Our sync with the accounting system is unchanged.
The pricing page gets a full redesign, with the three plans side by side.
To wrap up, the customer survey came back: eight out of ten would recommend us.
We have not set the next meeting yet.
